$comment: Consumed by powershell/arm/Invoke-ArmTtk.ps1. Every skipped test must carry a reason so the exemption is reviewable in pull requests.

skip.test: IDs Should Be Derived From ResourceIDs
skip.reason: Modules receive subnet, workspace and vault resource IDs as string parameters from the orchestrator, which this test cannot trace across templateLink boundaries. IDs are built with resourceId() in main.json.

Optional module parameters (privateEndpointSubnetId, logAnalyticsWorkspaceId, Git settings) default to an empty string or array on purpose; the matching resources are guarded with condition expressions.
